blocks.x: What about the Imperial band? Was that any good?
Well, I think it was. I think it was a good band. Uh-huh. You know, it was...
Sam Morgan, that was a good band.
Do you remember who was in with Sam? Which...
You know, he had two bands, and I just wondered which band was the best. See, the second band recorded after he had his stroke. Yeah. So I never... Well, I think that...
The first band was the best. With Alfred on drums.
Yeah, Alfred on drums. Yeah. Thomas Copeland, he had three bass players on the drums. Yeah. I think that was. You ever played with them? No, no. They had a whole couple of bands. Yeah.
They had Joe Watson I think on the ground.
Joe Watson was on the ground? With Sam I think at one time at the first band.
He probably was, yeah I know him well too.
Yeah. Would you say that Sam Morgan was like a fake band? Was what? Fake band? Fake band, you know did they use music?
Well they used some music too.
But I think the majority of the work was a member, you know.
